# Huntboard

Huntboard is a personal job-search tool. A single user pastes their CV and
target titles, then Huntboard scores incoming job listings against that
profile, explains why each one matched, and drafts a tailored CV and cover
letter for review. Sending an application is always a manual, human action;
the tool never submits anything on its own.

Huntboard is not a public job board and not an auto-apply service. It has no
public content pages beyond the sign-in screen; everything else requires
authentication and is specific to the one account that owns it.
